# Discrete Random

![Discrete Random function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/28-discrete_random.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Exact per-law NI connector types with explicit GS normalized IDs. Gamma uses shape=c,scale=b; Weibull uses scale=a,shape=b despite contradictory NI descriptions. Extreme Value is GS minimum orientation. Random state is per native instance/node; deterministic GS seed policy is not NI sequence identity.  GS RNG uses per-node mt19937_64: seed -1 picks instance entropy, nonnegative seeds are deterministic, Reset replays the seed, a changed seed reseeds; seed&lt;-1 is refused. No NI bit-sequence equivalence is claimed.
